description: Exakta于1973年推出的胶片单反相机。

specs.英文简介: The Exakta Twin TL is a 35 mm SLR camera, made for Ihagee Kamerawerk AG ('Ihagee West') by Petri in 1970[http://exaktaphile.net/captjack/Exakta%20Twin%20TL%20&%20Later%20Pseudo%20Exaktas.htm Twin TL] and other Ihagee West/Cosina cameras, at [http://exaktaphile.net Captain Jack's Exakta Pages] (McKeown gives the date as about 1973 p439-40.), and later by Cosina.
